messages:
auditor_miguel: Hi all — fieldwork ask: for the March 14 incident please assemble definitive artifacts we can drop into the SOC2 bundle showing: RBAC change timeline (who/what/when), KMS rotation proof tied to ciphertext versions, immutable artifact snapshot + checksum, and the vuln triage notes that led to mitigations. Need concrete file links and short query snippets we can paste.

tara: @auditor_miguel yep. We can produce a single "proof pack" with everything. High level pointers: RBAC -> terraform state + cloud audit events; KMS -> AWS KMS key rotation + ciphertext metadata; snapshot -> WORM S3 copy + sha256 file + GPG-signed manifest; vuln notes -> ticket #INC-2025-214 and triage.md.

raj: RBAC detail: rolebinding removal was via terraform apply at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z. Remote state recorded plan/apply diffs. CloudTrail event id: 86a3f7b2-11c4-4d9d-a2e7-9f3e1b2c0a55 (DeleteRolePolicy / iam:DetachRolePolicy) and console login by ops@redwood.com. Short query (CloudTrail):
```
{ eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" && eventName in ["DetachRolePolicy","DeleteRolePolicy","UpdateAssumeRolePolicy"] }
```
We exported matching events to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/iam-change-events.json.gz

samir: KMS: We rotated the CMK (alias/serving-cmk) and promoted version v3 as primary at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. CloudTrail shows ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey calls with requestParameters.cryptoKeyVersionId. Example ciphertext header includes keyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-...:3". We exported decrypt/encrypt logs to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/kms-events.jsonl and captured the key versions in SIEM. Query (CloudTrail Insight):
```
lookup eventName=Encrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt | where requestParameters.cryptoKeyVersionId == "...:3"
```
We also have KMS key metadata snapshot: kms-key-archive/serving-cmk-20250314.json (stored in write-once bucket).

evidence-bot: auto-export: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/manifest.json.sig (sha256: a3c9f...), signed-by: ops@redwood.com (GPG fingerprint 9A12 B3C4 D5E6 F789 01AB CDEF 2345 6789 A1B2 C3D4) ; wrom-bucket copy: s3://redwood-worm/6158642000/bundle.tar.gz (retention-locked).

tara: Snapshot/hash details: bundle.tar.gz.sha256 contains the ascii checksum; manifest.json lists filenames + sha256s; manifest.json.sig is an ASCII-armored GPG signature (key id 0xA1B2C3D4). We'll provide a presigned GET for manifest.json.sig and bundle.tar.gz (7-day expiry) for the auditor package.

raj: Vulnerability triage: CVE-2025-0421 (example) observed on image redwood/serving:2.3. Triage notes in the incident ticket: INC-2025-214, mitigation was image rebuild + redeploy at 2025-03-14T09:45Z. We exported the deploy job logs and rolling-update events to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/triage.md and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/deploy-log.txt.gz

auditor_miguel: Nice. A couple of clarifying asks: 1) For RBAC, can you show the exact terraform state diff or plan output we can include (redacted for secrets)? 2) For KMS, auditor wants cryptographic linkage showing ciphertexts after rotation reference new key version (not just API call). 3) For snapshot, confirm retention lock policy and whether the object metadata is preserved when uploading (we need to know where sha256 is stored).

samir: 1) Terraform: exported remote-state diff file: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/terraform-diff.txt (we redacted account ids). Snippet:
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svcacct_attach" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
+ (removed)
```
2) KMS cryptographic linkage: we captured a sample ciphertext envelope in the object metadata for encrypted artifacts; header field "x-amz-meta-kms-key-version" == "3" for post-rotation uploads. Also CloudTrail ReEncrypt entries include destinationKeyVersionId == 3. We'll include a decrypted log entry (redacted) that shows keyVersionId.
3) Retention: write-once bucket uses Object Lock in Governance mode with a 365-day retention. The sha256 file is stored as a separate object (.sha256) and the manifest includes checksums; object metadata is preserved on copy to WORM bucket.

evidence-bot: generated presigned links (expires 168h): 
- manifest: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/manifest.json.sig?X
- bundle: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6158642000/bundle.tar.gz?X

tara: I'll assemble a one-page control map entry (plain text) with the following fields: Control ID, What happened, Evidence files (with presigned links), Exact audit queries, Retention location + retention policy, Cryptographic assertions (GPG fingerprint, KMS key ARN + version used), Redactions (if any), and Owner. Posting in ~20m.

auditor_miguel: Great — please include the raw CloudTrail event id(s) and the terraform apply timestamp. If you can paste the small ciphertext header sample that will close it out. Thanks team.

samir: Adding note: we've also attached a small test proof (bundle-manifest-check.txt) that shows verifying the manifest signature with the ops public key and computing sha256 of the bundle. Will include verification steps in the control map.

auditor_miguel: Perfect. Leaving this thread open for the control map and the final presigned links. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:
